claims.statement: The fragment points to the Runner groups tab. It supplies no enclosing page, runner-group membership, repository access policy, actor entitlement or isolation proof; no runner configuration was changed.
The fragment points to the Runners tab. It is not an inventory, registration receipt, online-health test or permission grant, and no runners were registered or altered.
The fragment locates Actions under Policies. Opening that menu does not establish effective enterprise Actions restrictions, allowed actions, inheritance, protection or actor permissions.

The fragment starts domain addition beside Verified and approved domains for the enterprise account. Clicking Add a domain is not DNS ownership verification, completed approval, exclusive domain control or permission to mutate DNS; no domain or DNS setting changed.
The fragment locates Administrators under People. It does not supply administrator role definitions, owner or billing-manager equivalence, actual membership, authorization or an observed role change.

The per-organization Advanced Security product dropdown is optional and conditional on first choosing Allow for selected organizations. Product availability is not actual security enablement, licensing entitlement, complete repository coverage or enforcement. The screenshot caption is not image inspection or a saved-setting receipt; no product, cost or policy change was performed.
